entry.name: tool invocation
entry.definition: The MCP server requests that the library invoke a tool.

entry.name: invocation forwarding
entry.definition: The library forwards a tool invocation to the verifier.

entry.name: invocation result
entry.definition: The verifier sends the result of a tool invocation to the library.

entry.name: result forwarding
entry.definition: The library forwards an invocation result to the MCP server.

entry.name: cancellation invocation
entry.definition: The MCP server requests that the library cancel a particular tool invocation.

entry.name: cancellation forwarding
entry.definition: The library forwards a cancellation request for a particular tool invocation to the verifier.

entry.name: outcome
entry.definition: The result the library returns to the application for an invocation.

entry.name: outcome persistence
entry.definition: Once an invocation has an outcome, that outcome remains unchanged, including when later messages arrive.

entry.name: detected failure
entry.definition: A concrete failure observed by the library, such as notification that the prover connection has terminated.

entry.name: cancellation request
entry.definition: A request to stop a particular invocation. Making the request does not establish that execution has stopped.

entry.name: cancellation acknowledgement
entry.definition: A reply confirming receipt of a cancellation request.

entry.name: execution termination
entry.definition: The invocation's computation in the verifier has stopped. This is internal state of the verifier state machine.

entry.name: invocation isolation
entry.definition: A result or cancellation for one invocation affects only that invocation's outcome.
